steps.action: Archiving an in-use type moves its records to the chosen replacement
steps.actual: The dialog read "Archive Ind supplier assessment IND81T2F revised Ind supplier assessment IND81T2F revised is used by 2 matters. Pick a replacement type — those matters move to it when the type is archived. Reassign 2 matters to No reassignment Employment L". Choosing "Ind replacement type IND81T2F" archived the type and moved Matter 24 to "Ind replacement type IND81T2F".

steps.action: Restoring the type does not move the reassigned record back
steps.actual: Restore returned "Ind supplier assessment IND81T2F revised" to the live list (archivedAt=null), but Matter 24 still reads type "Ind replacement type IND81T2F".
The Other row offers no archive control (0) and shows the protected lock (1).

steps.action: Archiving an in-use Officer role moves current and resigned appointments
steps.actual: Two appointments used the role: current "Ind Current Officer IND81T2F" and resigned "Ind Former Officer IND81T2F" (resignedOn 2024-05-06). The row read "Ind compliance officer IND81T2F / 2 officers" and the dialog read "Archive Ind compliance officer IND81T2F Ind compliance officer IND81T2F is used by 2 officers. Pick a replacement role — those officers move to it when the role is archived. Reassign 2 officers to No reassignment Directo". After archiving with "Ind compliance officer IND81T2F spare" as replacement both moved: Ind Current Officer IND81T2F -> Ind compliance officer IND81T2F spare (resignedOn none); Ind Former Officer IND81T2F -> Ind compliance officer IND81T2F spare (resignedOn 2024-05-06).

steps.action: Restoring an Officer role does not reverse the reassignment
steps.actual: Restore made "Ind compliance officer IND81T2F" selectable again (archivedAt=null) while both appointments stayed on the replacement: Ind Current Officer IND81T2F -> Ind compliance officer IND81T2F spare; Ind Former Officer IND81T2F -> Ind compliance officer IND81T2F spare. The Other role still shows the protected lock (1).
